headline: Iranian Supreme Leader Khamenei Declared Martyr, Triggering Leadership Crisis in Iran
subheadline: Millions expected to attend funeral ceremonies for Khamenei in Tehran, Najaf, and Karbala as Iran faces critical leadership transition amid regional tensions.
lede: Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Khamenei has been reported martyred, prompting massive funeral preparations in Tehran and Iraq's Najaf and Karbala with millions expected to attend. Israeli forces intensified pressure on Hezbollah, eliminating a terrorist at Ali Taher ridge and announcing 83% destruction of Gaza border tunnels. An Iranian Kurdish opposition camp in Koy Sanjaq, Erbil, was targeted by drones while IRGC clashes erupted near Sardasht and Piranshahr, and a deadly explosion at a Damascus cafe killed 4-9 people. A Tajik citizen with a Russian passport was arrested in Israel for spying for Iran during the 'Roar of the Lion' operation, underscoring persistent intelligence penetration.

sections.title: Russian Drone Campaign Hits Ukrainian Infrastructure
sections.body: Russian forces claim to have shot down 100 Ukrainian drones over the Black and Azov Seas in the past 12 hours, indicating intense air‑defence pressure. Ukraine has requested Patriot missiles from 40 countries following Russian attacks that caused widespread power outages across Kiev, Donets, Zaporizhzhia, and Kharkiv regions. Drone activity continued across Chernihiv, Dnipropetrovsk, Donets, and Kharkiv, including a Shahed crossing into Kyiv’s Brovarskyi district and strikes near Apostolovoye‑Zelenodolskaya, while a Russian strike destroyed a book warehouse in Kiev, burning 800,000 volumes.

sections.title: Iranian Leadership Vacuum Triggers Regional Escalation
sections.body: The reported martyrdom of Supreme Leader Khamenei has created a critical leadership vacuum, prompting massive funeral ceremonies in Tehran, Najaf, and Karbala expected to draw millions. Israeli forces maintained pressure on Hezbollah, eliminating a terrorist exiting underground infrastructure at Ali Taher ridge, while Defense Minister Katz announced 83% destruction of Gaza’s border tunnels. Drone attacks targeted an Iranian Kurdish opposition camp in Koy Sanjaq, Erbil, and IRGC clashed with Kurdish groups near Sardasht and Piranshahr, coinciding with a deadly Damascus cafe explosion that killed 4-9 and injured 10-20, and the arrest of a Tajik citizen with a Russian passport in Israel for spying for Iran.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The simultaneous death of Khamenei, Israeli operations, Iranian‑Kurdish clashes, and spy arrest indicate multi‑axis instability and potential IRGC escalation. Russian drone claims and Ukraine’s Patriot request show continued air‑defence pressure and reliance on external support. The data points to heightened force protection and possible succession‑driven proxy coordination.
